title: ObservationPayload
description: An event a Body observed and reports to its own agent (AN-24, decision 0343). Proposed: the wording is unapproved (OD-E) and nothing publishes an observation yet. The actor is set only when a visible causal actor caused the event; otherwise the actor is absent and the event stays unattributed.

ActorName.description: A Minecraft player name, as the game allows it.

ObservedActor.description: A visible causal actor: the name the game shows and the life id the registry gives that name.

basis.description: How the agent could know the name (decision 0450): seen in view, spoke in chat, or signed a sign. The observation sentence names the actor only when basis is present; absent, the sentence says Someone.

actor.description: The visible giver. Absent when the giver is not visible: the gift is unattributed.
The visible breaker. Absent when the breaker is not visible: the observation is unattributed.

FightSeen.description: A fight near the Body, with a visible player or none. target is the mob type without namespace (AN-46). Producers are off by default.

actor.description: The visible fighter. Absent when no fighter is visible: the observation is unattributed.

ContainerTaken.description: Items taken from a container of the Body's. Producers are off by default (AN-46).

actor.description: The visible taker. Absent when the taker is not visible: the observation is unattributed.
